hook.en: Just as a diary records events day by day, the journal records every transaction in the order of date, showing which account is debited and which is credited.
hook.kn: ದಿನಚರಿ ದಿನದಿಂದ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಘಟನೆಗಳನ್ನು ದಾಖಲಿಸುವಂತೆ, ರೋಜು ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಪ್ರತಿ ವ್ಯವಹಾರವನ್ನು ದಿನಾಂಕದ ಕ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಡೆಬಿಟ್ ಮತ್ತು ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಸಹಿತ ದಾಖಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: The journal is the book of original (prime) entry. It has five columns: Date, Particulars, Ledger Folio (L.F.), Debit amount and Credit amount. In the particulars column the account to be debited is written first with "Dr", the account to be credited on the next line beginning with "To", and below it a short narration explaining the transaction. Recording in the journal is called journalising.
body.kn: ರೋಜು ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಮೂಲ ನಮೂದು ಪುಸ್ತಕ. ಅದರಲ್ಲಿ ದಿನಾಂಕ, ವಿವರ, ಖಾತೆ ಪುಟ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ, ಡೆಬಿಟ್ ಮೊತ್ತ ಮತ್ತು ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಮೊತ್ತ ಎಂಬ ಐದು ಕಾಲಂಗಳಿವೆ. ಕೆಳಗೆ ಸಂಕ್ಷಿಪ್ತ ವಿವರಣೆ ಬರೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Debit line ends with "Dr"; credit line starts with "To"

body.en: A simple entry has one debit and one credit. A compound entry has more than one debit or credit, for example when a machine is bought partly for cash and partly on credit. Goods bought for resale are debited to Purchases, but assets bought for use, such as furniture or machinery, are debited to their own accounts.
body.kn: ಸರಳ ನಮೂದಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಡೆಬಿಟ್ ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದು ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್. ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ ನಮೂದಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಡೆಬಿಟ್ ಅಥವಾ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್. ಮಾರಾಟಕ್ಕೆ ಕೊಂಡ ಸರಕು ಖರೀದಿ ಖಾತೆಗೆ; ಬಳಕೆಗೆ ಕೊಂಡ ಆಸ್ತಿ ಅದರದೇ ಖಾತೆಗೆ.

Assets bought: debit the asset account

problem.en: Journalise for Kavya Traders, April 2025: 1 Started business with cash ₹1,50,000; 3 Deposited ₹60,000 into bank; 5 Bought goods on credit from Mohan ₹40,000; 8 Sold goods for cash ₹25,000; 12 Paid salary ₹8,000.

steps.en: Apr 1: Cash A/c Dr 1,50,000; To Capital A/c 1,50,000 (business started).
Apr 3: Bank A/c Dr 60,000; To Cash A/c 60,000 (cash deposited).
Apr 5: Purchases A/c Dr 40,000; To Mohan 40,000 (goods bought on credit).
Apr 8: Cash A/c Dr 25,000; To Sales A/c 25,000 (cash sales).
Apr 12: Salary A/c Dr 8,000; To Cash A/c 8,000 (salary paid).

narration.en: Let us work this out step by step. Journalise for Kavya Traders, April 2025: 1 Started business with cash ₹1,50,000; 3 Deposited ₹60,000 into bank; 5 Bought goods on credit from Mohan ₹40,000; 8 Sold goods for cash ₹25,000; 12 Paid salary ₹8,000.
